summary: Makes the camera generate the depth texture that shoreline foam needs.
overview: A water shader sampling the camera depth texture for shoreline foam needs the CAMERA to actually generate it, and a shader cannot request that itself. Drop this on whatever camera sees the water.
useCases: Shoreline foam where water meets terrain.
Any depth-based water effect such as depth-tinted shallows.
Fixing foam that works in one scene and not another.

gotchas.title: Missing it looks like a broken shader, not a missing setting
gotchas.body: Foam simply does not appear, with no error anywhere. If shoreline foam is absent, this is almost always the reason.
